title: Scenario cards carry an app code; the runner and gallery use the demo<code> namespace and refuse a bare non-object item name
body:
epic:#3600#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPXwX1YfHyKJUh4agu

Filing-gate category: ② maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, verbatim (Claude Code session, 2026-11-06), answering the seat's proposals (the card `code` field and the `demo` + code namespace; gallery apps prefix every item name, not only objects): 「同意，裸名的问题立决策卡」. Epic: objectstack-ai/cloud#3600.

Blocked-by: #30770

(Serial: both edit `docs/qa/scenarios/crm_account_with_contacts.json`.)

## Problem

The runner (#30746, merged) reads cards namespace-relative against whatever namespace the scaffold declares, so a scored build's names differ between runs and machines, and nothing stops a build from shipping bare non-object names that collide when two gallery apps share an environment. The gallery needs stable, readable, collision-free names.

## Ask

1. **Card field `code`**: 2–8 lowercase letters, no underscore, unique across all cards. The loader refuses a missing, malformed or duplicate code. Add it to every card under `docs/qa/scenarios/`, including cards the devx mid-tier lane lands meanwhile (#30477, #30479, #30481: coordinate with `domain:devx#1` through `Notify: serial`).
2. **Namespace `demo` + `code`** (e.g. `democrm`): the runner scaffolds every project with it, in scratch and template modes, and the gallery exporter (#30349) uses the same namespace.
3. **Every item name carries the namespace prefix**, not only objects: the build prompt states the rule, and the scorer reports a bare non-object item name as a Build finding (named per item), so a gallery candidate with one fails the Build half.
4. Keep the namespace-relative reading (ruling A on #30292) for card object names; it now always resolves against `demo<code>`.

Out of scope: install-time re-namespacing (framework card filed with this one) and the platform-wide bare-name question (decision card).

Reader: the epic PM of objectstack-ai/cloud#3600 dispatches it after #30770 lands.
